Buried in the [[Swamp]] | durability = 5 | tool tier = 0 | resistances = pickaxe only }} A '''Muddy Scrap Pile''' is a resource node and are found predominantly inside [[Sunken Crypts]] within the [[Swamp]] biome and require a [[Pickaxes (Skill)|Pickaxe]] to be harvested. They have 5 health per segment, making all pickaxes equally good at mining them. == Availability == Besides being found in the Sunken Crypts, they can also rarely be found underground in the Swamp. Generally, the player will need a [[Wishbone]] to find these deposits. However, due to these nodes extending below the water line, it can be challenging to effectively mine them. When mined, they uniquely do not guarantee resources but instead have a small chance of dropping [[Scrap Iron]], [[Leather Scraps]] or [[Withered Bone]]s. == Drops == In Sunken Crypts, Muddy Scrap Piles have 30 segments and each segment may drop the following when mined: {{loot table| {{loot row|item=Scrap Iron|amt=1|rate=14.29%
(avg. 4.3 per pile)}} {{loot row|item=Leather Scraps|amt=1|rate=2.86%
(avg. 0.86 per pile)}} {{loot row|item=Withered Bone|amt=1|rate=2.86%
(avg. 0.86 per pile)}} }} The Muddy Scrap Piles found outdoors in the Swamp have 20 segments, each segment may drop: {{loot table| {{loot row|item=Scrap Iron|amt=1|rate=29.7%
(avg. 6 per pile)}} {{loot row|item=Withered Bone|amt=1|rate=0.3%
(avg. 0.06 per pile)}} }} == Notes == * Metal deposits do not respawn. * Muddy Scrap Piles are the only metal resource currently in the game not to guarantee items upon being mined. * Like other metals, the resulting Scrap iron cannot be teleported through a [[Portal|Wood portal]] * Enemies or [[Body Pile|Body Piles]] on the other side of a Muddy Scrap Pile can be safely damaged or destroyed by the AoE effect from a 2-handed mace such as the [[Stagbreaker]] or the [[Iron Sledge]], without damaging the Muddy Scrap Pile itself. The '''Spinning Wheel''' is a crafting station which converts {{Item link|Flax}} into {{Item link|Linen Thread}}. Each piece of Flax takes 30 seconds to convert into Linen thread. It has a capacity of 40 Flax, and will drop Linen as it is made automatically.

The Spinning Wheel becomes available after the player has killed [[Moder]] to obtain the materials for an [[Artisan Table]]. It must be placed within the radius of the Artisan Table, but does not require it to function after placement.

[[Resin]]|image1=[[fir large.png]]}} Fir is a type of tree that can be found in the [[Black Forest]], [[Swamp]], and [[Mountain]] biomes. It is characterized by its dark brown trunk and long pointed branches. Fir can be found in small and large variants. Both variants can be chopped with a [[Stone Axe]] or better. The small variant produces 4 [[Wood]] when destroyed. The large variant produces 20 [[wood]] when destroyed, and the stump will yield another 2 wood. Fir will sometimes produce a [[Fir Cone]] when destroyed, which can be planted using the [[Cultivator]]. Cutting down a fir tree leaves a stump which is too low to be struck by the regular blow of the axe. '''Poison''' is a negative [[status effect]] that applies a damage overtime effect on the affected entity. It is caused by [[Damage types#Poison|Poison damage]].

All resistances like [[Poison Resistance Mead]] are applied at the time of creating the effect and ignored on tick. Therefore any change to resistances after the effect start doesn't change it.

=== Stacking ===
Poison damage does not stack. The effect calculates how much damage remains to be dealt, and if a new poisonous attacks deals more poison damage than the remaining one, the effect is re-created. Otherwise, that incoming damage is ignored.

== Calculations ==
Duration from total damage is calculated (see below for more precise numbers) as <math>\lceil (1 + \sqrt{X*damage}) \rceil</math> where X is 5 against players and 1 against enemies. This means Poison lasts roughly twice as long for players and halves the tick damage. See further section for the technical details.

Tick damage is calculated with <math>{total \ damage \over duration}</math>.

=== Extra damage ===
Theoretically, the total damage from all ticks should be the same as initial value, but due to rounding the total damage is slightly higher.

* First we take non-integer value of <math>duration</math> as: <math>1 + \sqrt{X*damage}</math>
* then we take <math>damagePerHit = \frac{totalDamage}{\lfloor duration \rfloor}</math>
* then actual number of ticks is <math>\lfloor \frac{duration}{1.02} \rfloor + 1</math>.

Where does this come from? Due to floating number peculiarities<ref>https://0.30000000000000004.com/</ref> and the fact, that Valheim runs physics on fixed 50 FPS, every tick takes 1.02 seconds, but since first tick happens at the beginning of duration, when time = 0, we have an extra one.

Here's a table with calculations for various damage values: [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vSrjL9LtSGBgIAgr7Y_9Kej79ZQ9bh70ND9pNOAeCA5axUGA-AEp4FKdGhra-co-8RdeMpB5TLrlsV-/pubhtml Poison damage google spreadsheets].

An '''Obsidian Deposit''' is a resource node and is found in the [[Mountain]]s biome and require an [[Iron Pickaxe]] or better to harvest.

== Availability ==
Obsidian Deposits appear as small, sphere-shaped rocks with distinct black colored veins, which help differentiate them from regular rocks at a distance. They yield [[Obsidian]] when mined.

They are only found on the surface.

== Drops ==
{{loot table|
{{loot row|item=Obsidian|amt=5-8|rate=100%}}
}}

== Notes ==
* Obsidian Deposits do not respawn.
* Unlike other resources that require mining, Obsidian can be teleported.

The '''Eitr Refinery''' is a structure used for processing {{Item Link|Sap}} and {{Item Link|Soft Tissue}} into {{Item Link|Refined Eitr}}.

== Building ==
Eitr Refinery is unlocked once the player has the required materials. A [[Black Metal Axe]] is required to obtain [[Yggdrasil Wood]], and a [[Sap Extractor]] is required to obtain [[Sap]]. The sap extractor requires a [[Dvergr Extractor]] obtained from [[Dvergr Component Crate]]s in Dvergr settlements. [[Infested Mine]]s must also be explored to obtain [[Black Core]]s.

Eitr Refineries can be constructed on flat terrain or on stone floors, but degrade from rain when not under a roof.

== Usage ==
Up to 20 [[Sap]] can be supplied into the funnel at the front of the refinery, and up to 20 [[Soft Tissue]] can be inserted into the grinder at the top. It is possible to climb to the top of the grinder, but constructing stairs makes accessing it easier. The resulting [[Refined Eitr]] is ejected from the tube next to the sap input, opposite the grinder.

The sap:soft tissue ratio is roughly 20:20. Each sap (acting as a fuel) adds 40 seconds, and the operating time on a full fuel tank is 800 seconds. But filling both the Sap and Soft tissue slots to the max will consume 20 Soft tissue and 19 Sap to produce 20 Refined eitr, leaving 1 Sap (probably due to a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Round-off_error round-off error]).

While processing, small discharges are emitted from the structure, inflicting Lightning and Poison [[Damage]] over time. The eitr dropped on the ground will also emit these discharges, which will eventually damage and destroy structures not immune to elemental damage. Structures immune to elemental damage include [[Cage Wall 2x2|iron]] and [[Dvergr metal wall|copper]] cage pieces, and [[Black Marble]] floor/wall/pillars. Wood and ordinary stone structures will take damage. 

== Notes ==
* As with other [[Mistlands]]-tier structures and items, this can theoretically be obtained before building a [[Wisp Fountain]], but navigation is made difficult by the intense mist.

'''Unstable Lava Rocks''' are resource nodes found in the [[Ashlands]] biome, being a source of {{Item link|Proustite Powder}}.

When destroyed by receiving 50 or more damage from any weapon or a [[pickaxe]], they explode. The explosion damages surrounding objects, including players, creatures and structures. Additionally, it creates a small crater in the ground.

== Availability ==
Unstable Lava Rocks can often be found attached to large boulders and stones in the [[Ashlands]] biome, as well as on the ground occasionally.

== Notes ==
* The explosion deals 75 pure damage, regardless of armor rating, and is unblockable. It also deals 500 Chop and 600 Pickaxe damage, but the player is immune to these types of damage.
* The explosion has a tool tier of 4, one higher than Black metal.
* Unstable Lava Rocks can be safely destroyed by shooting them with a [[bow]] or [[crossbows|crossbow]]. [[Frost Arrow]]s are particularly efficient.
